pages.title: Mushroom Quest
pages.text: **Mushroom Quest** is a foraging mod. It adds dozens of wild mushrooms, giant logs and stumps with mushrooms on them, and cooking. Some are food, some medicine, some poison.

pages.title: Mycopedia
pages.text: A field guide for identifying mushrooms and learning their rarity.

Be careful: eating the wrong one can poison you, and a fungal disease exists. The mod's advancements mention medicinal, poisonous and deadly types, so identify before eating. Cooking uses campfire, smoking, smelting and shapeless recipes.

pages.title: Miso Soup
pages.text: Cooked dishes turn mushrooms into safer food.
It is a good match for [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]()-style cooking, which also has mushroom crops (Fungi Delight). A Witchy Cottage structure exists too.
